clips.title: Chef idle
clips.description: A gentle sideways paw lift at half the previous amplitude.

clips.title: Walking
clips.description: Visible forward/back steps, planted short paws and opposing arm swings.

clips.title: Dash burst
clips.description: Forward body lean, quick running feet, travel and fading shadow silhouettes.

clips.title: Hold a plate
clips.description: Two paws support a level plate with a quiet breathing loop.

clips.title: Walk with a plate
clips.description: A walking cycle with the plate kept level between the paws.

clips.title: Throw an ingredient
clips.description: Wind-up, release, ingredient arc over the rail and follow-through.

clips.title: Chop a tomato
clips.description: Three knife strokes, then the same ingredient changes to its chopped state.

clips.title: Wash a dirty plate
clips.description: A small up/down stroke at the plate rim, then a clean dish is picked up.

clips.title: Fight a kitchen fire
clips.description: A gentle sway while aiming and spraying. Flames shrink and stop.

clips.title: Seated customer idle
clips.description: A small seated paw lift, matching the gentler chef idle.

clips.title: Customer eating
clips.description: A visible paw-to-mouth bite and a return to the table.

clips.title: Overcooking → fire
clips.description: Steam → eight seconds of small warning flames → spreading fire. The last three warning seconds become more urgent.
